items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I know Jacquet they would call and King Cole and Red Callender--a few of them, you know, I knew

ctx.x: Remember some of the people who played for him?

No. I didn't meddle with his business, you know. I just rented him the hall, and I know Jacquet they would call and King Cole and Red Callender--a few of them, you know, I knew, but a lot of those white boys who had big names--I didn't know them. I knew them when I heard 'em talked about but I didn't know 'em personally or anything.
How about, did you present musical...jam sessions or dances or anything there?
